profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, Insurance Benefits at Justworks
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working with web technologies.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: As a member of the www.makerbot.com and store.makerbot.com team I worked on Node.js-based microservices and static site generating tools as part of an effort to transition away from the legacy PHP-based marketing site and e-commerce site. I was also responsible for the updating and maintenance of these legacy properties.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: As a member of the Vivastreet team, I was responsible for updating and maintaining all web-driven aspects of the product which was a PHP-based classified ads site including the REST API, search engine, SEO, analytics, reporting, administrative and moderation tools, mail delivery, and e-commerce.
